Road Accident in Hayathnagar Injures Multiple Passengers

A road accident occurred in Hayathnagar where a lorry collided with an RTC bus. Reports indicate that between 15 and 20 passengers sustained injuries in the incident. The collision involved a tipper lorry and a Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TSRTC) bus.
